mostWorthwhile.text: Building the grain bin was most worthwhile: its raised base and fitted lid explained how it protects the grain from damp.

leastWorthwhile.text: Putting the dried fruit into a separate covered jar felt repetitive after making the drying rack and drying the fruit.

surprise.text: The pickle goal appeared only after I stored the dried fruit.

arbitrary.text: The drying goal remained incomplete after the fruit was dried; I had to infer that it also required storage.

continue.text: I would probably stop here: the storage details were interesting, but the later sequence offered little meaningful choice.
